alternatives.reason: Version 1 selected claude-opus-5-5 for both runs, capped at US$3 for authoring and US$1 for review. The founder asked for a more capable model and a looser cap on 2026-10-26, since the credit would otherwise go unused. A probe on 2026-10-26 showed the key can call claude-fable-5-1, and that for the same tokens it costs about 2.5 times claude-opus-5-5 (US$0.0210 vs US$0.0084). The cap is a guard against a runaway edit-test loop, not a saving.

The demo copy has no remote and no CI of its own, so a candidate there cannot carry real Git or CI evidence; roadmap G3 asks for both. The founder chose the external repository github.com/williamlabdev/order-operations-portal, which is public and runs its own test and build jobs.

EB-012 already recorded one interactive run (ARR-002, Claude in Cowork). It cannot be replayed from a script, and the commands the agent ran are only what the agent reported. The founder chose a headless claude -p run started by a harness, whose transcript is captured as it happens.

It would give the agent git, network and GitHub credentials. The harness keeps those: the agent only edits files and runs go test, go vet and gofmt. The harness checks the changed paths against allowed_paths before it commits, so an out-of-scope edit stops the run before anything is pushed. Agent proposal, not a founder ruling.

Both would mean writing and hosting an agent loop. ContextRail does not host agents (roadmap scope), and the developer-side tool G3 asks about is an external coding agent the developer already uses, Claude Code.

The agent proposed copying the demo over the external repository. The founder chose a bidirectional sync with the external repository as the single source. The divergence was in both directions: the external repository had REQ-002 evidence links, and the demo had the healthz identity and local topology that DR-017 needs. A one-way copy would have dropped one side.

architecture_impact: No ContextRail code changes. The run exercises existing surfaces: change, decision, work order, candidate with read_back github (internal/change/readback.go), release build, approval and a source local deployment (DR-017).

Precondition: order-operations-portal PR #2 and context-rail PR #26 align the external repository and the demo copy in both directions and must be merged before the run. Both were merged on 2026-10-26 on the founder's command (external c3c2337, context-rail 4f0bfae); EB-019 run 2 cloned external main at c3c2337. Without PR #2 the external main (d843463) has neither the healthz identity nor the local topology DR-017 reads. From then on the external repository is the single source; the demo is a fixture synced from it and is not edited first. Its manifest keeps the placeholder repository block, because tests/registry/contract_test.go pins fixture-pending-remote.

scripts/agent-run.sh starts ContextRail with CONTEXT_RAIL_ADVISOR=rule, with a fresh clone of the external main as the Project root, and with GITHUB_TOKEN set only on that command line. The work order's repository is therefore the real github.com/williamlabdev/order-operations-portal, not the demo placeholder.

The change asks for GET /api/orders?status=<status>: return only orders in that status, return the full list when status is absent, and answer 400 for an unknown status. Tests are part of the change. Base main, target branch agent/order-status-filter (run N of the harness appends -N from N = 2, so EB-019 run 2 used agent/order-status-filter-2), work-order allowed_paths main.go and main_test.go of the external repository. The work order's required checks are allowed-paths-diff-check and independent-review plus the staging environment's requiredEvidence in the external project.yaml (decision-record, review, single-operator-controls, test, build, smoke); test and build are observed as the external CI check-runs of the same names. The Context Pack does not hash main.go or main_test.go, so the agent's edit leaves it current.

The harness renders the agent prompt from the issued work order: its id and hash, the change text, allowed_paths, forbidden_actions and acceptance. It runs claude -p --bare --permission-mode dontAsk --tools Read,Edit,Bash --model claude-fable-5-1 --max-budget-usd 20 --no-session-persistence --output-format stream-json --verbose in the clone, with --allowedTools pre-approving Read, Edit, Bash(go test:*), Bash(go vet:*) and Bash(gofmt:*), and --disallowedTools naming Read rules for the founder's source tree outside the clone, ~/.config, ~/.ssh and ~/.claude. --allowedTools only pre-approves: without an explicit mode the child inherits the caller's permission mode, and run 1 of EB-019 ran in auto mode, so the classifier, not the allowlist, decided (version 3). dontAsk denies any call that is not pre-approved and --tools removes the other built-ins; the harness reads permissionMode and the tool list from each run's init event and stops if they differ. --bare does not isolate the run from the developer's setup: the init events of EB-019 list the founder's installed plugins.

ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is read from the founder's local .env file and placed on the claude command line only; it is never exported, logged or written to evidence. Before the transcript is saved, it is scanned for the key, and any hit aborts the run.

After the agent stops, the harness commits under the founder's git identity with an Agent-Run trailer naming the run id, then pushes the branch and opens the pull request with gh. It refuses to commit if any changed path is outside allowed_paths. It waits for the external CI with gh pr checks --watch.

The candidate is submitted with read_back {source: github, repository: williamlabdev/order-operations-portal, base: main, head: agent/order-status-filter}. Branch, commits, changed paths and checks come from GitHub, not from the agent. The AgentRun record names the agent (Claude Code headless, claude-fable-5-1), the adapter, the run id and the commands the agent declared, read from the transcript.

No second human exists, so the independent_review gate can only be WAIVED (internal/change/candidate.go independentReviewGate): single-operator-controls is a required check, an AI review is APPROVED and compensating controls are declared. The harness obtains the AI review from a second, separate claude -p --bare --model claude-opus-5-5 run with Read as its only tool, given the work order and the pull request diff, capped at US$5, so the reviewer is a different model from the author, which must answer APPROVED or CHANGES_REQUESTED with reasons; its transcript and verdict are saved in EB-019. The candidate declares that review and the compensating controls; MergeObservation keeps both next to the GitHub observation. CHANGES_REQUESTED stops the run before the candidate is accepted. The review run uses --permission-mode dontAsk --tools Read (version 3), so it can read the clone but cannot run commands or tests.

The binary is built from the candidate head commit and started locally as staging. A release is cut with source_commit set to that head commit and image_digest set to the binary's sha256, then approved and deployed with source local. DR-017 reads the identity back over loopback.
The agent's pull request is not merged by the run. Merging it, and then syncing the demo copy from the external main, is a separate step that needs the founder's command.
cost_assumptions: One authoring run (claude-fable-5-1, --max-budget-usd 20) and one review run (claude-opus-5-5, --max-budget-usd 5), billed to the promotional API credit: US$191.04 left on 2026-10-26 as read from Console by the founder, expiring 2026-11-10 UTC. Each transcript's total_cost_usd is recorded in EB-019.

If the first authoring run fails the acceptance checks, the review requests changes, or the run turns out not to match this record, it is kept as evidence and at most one more authoring and review pair is made with the same prompts, so at most US$50 in all. Version 3: EB-019 run 1 passed every check but ran under the inherited auto permission mode, so run 2 was made after the harness fix on the founder's ruling. Actual spend: run 1 US$0.679, run 2 US$0.867, permission probes about US$0.025.
External CI runs on a public repository, so it is not billed. ContextRail itself makes no model call (rule advisor).
unknowns: The candidate gate does not compare the observed repository with the work order's repository. The harness passes the right repository, but nothing in ContextRail would reject a read-back pointed at another repository. Recorded, not fixed here.

GitHubReadBack ignores errors from the pulls, review and check-run calls, so a transient GitHub error looks like missing evidence rather than an error. A check-run still in progress (empty conclusion) is read as FAIL, so the harness reads back only after gh pr checks --watch has finished.

Staging runs the candidate's head commit, not a merged main. Promotion evidence is about the reviewed change, and a later merge commit would be a different build (DR-017: the build digest changes with every commit).

The single-operator waiver (AI review plus declared compensating controls) covers accepting the candidate and approving the release; a distinct human reviewer is not exercised. The AI reviewer (claude-opus-5-5) is a different model from the author (claude-fable-5-1) but from the same vendor, so shared blind spots are reduced, not excluded.

In dontAsk, Claude Code still auto-allows shell commands it classifies as read-only (ls, cat, git status in the 2026-10-26 probe); only writes outside the allowlist are denied. The author can therefore read any file its user can read through such a command, and Bash(go test:*) runs test code that the agent wrote, on the founder's machine. The clone is a temporary directory and the key is the only secret in the process environment.

The reviewer's prompt contains the pull request diff, which the author run wrote, so the author can address text to the reviewer. The review is independent of the authoring run's context, not of its output.

The harness re-runs go vet, go test and scripts/validate-demo.sh on the agent's tree in its own shell, outside the agent's tool limits; test code the agent wrote runs there too. Every kept prompt, diff and transcript is checked for the API key and the GitHub token, and a hit aborts the run.

The --disallowedTools Read rules have not been exercised: EB-019 runs 1 and 2 passed them with a malformed absolute prefix (///Users/...). The harness now writes //Users/...; no run has used that form, so whether the rules hold is unknown.
acceptance_criteria: One claude -p run, started by scripts/agent-run.sh, edits only main.go and main_test.go of the external repository, and its transcript is saved in EB-019 without the key.

The harness opens a pull request on github.com/williamlabdev/order-operations-portal from agent/order-status-filter (or its -N suffix for run N ≥ 2) into main, and the external CI jobs test and build are seen green on it.
The candidate submitted with read_back github is VERIFIED from GitHub: branch, commits, changed paths and required checks are observed, not declared. It is accepted against the work order.
A separate read-only claude -p review run answers APPROVED on the pull request diff, its transcript is in EB-019, and the candidate's independent_review gate is WAIVED, not PASS.

A release built from the candidate head commit is promoted to the local staging environment with source local; the receipt binds that head commit, and the staging instance answers GET /api/orders?status=… as specified.
The run stops on its own: ContextRail and the staging instance are shut down and the temporary clone is removed. The external pull request stays open for the founder.
roadmap G3 is updated only after the above is seen in EB-019; CI is cited only if a run is actually seen green.

human_decision.reason: William 對 G3 的授權原話是「可以啊 我本來就有提供claude的api key對吧」。2026-10-26 他在 agent 提供的選項 UI 中裁決，以下為所選選項的標籤原文。目標 repo：「外部 order-operations-portal (Recommended)」。Agent：「我跑 headless claude -p (Recommended)」。改動內容：「訂單列表依狀態篩選 (Recommended)」。對齊方式：「雙向同步，外部設為唯一真相源」（否決 agent 建議的單向同步）。看到兩支同步 PR 的 CI 結果後，他回「好 等你的DR」。harness 掌管 git、AI 審查跑、預算上限、工具白名單、最多重跑一次，是 agent 在上述授權內提出的設計，與 DR-017 版本 1 相同處理：在本版提交給他時審閱，他若否決任何一項就開版本 2。at 為 agent 寫入本版的時刻。 版本 2：他問「其實額度可以開大一點 用聰明點的模組 因為其實根本用不完 還是你的目的是想先控制預算」。agent 探測確認 key 能呼叫 claude-fable-5-1 後，提出由 Fable 撰寫（上限 US$20）、Opus 審查（上限 US$5）、總上限 US$50。他回報 Console 餘額「191.04」，對 v2 設計、merge 兩支同步 PR、寫 harness 並實跑三件事回「都做」。 版本 3：EB-019 第 1 次實跑全綠，但兩支 claude -p 繼承了 auto mode，--allowedTools 沒有實際擋住（審查只給 Read 仍跑了 Bash）。agent 改成 dontAsk 加 --tools 並以探測確認後，在選項 UI 問他如何處理，他選「用修好的 harness 重跑 (Recommended)」；第 2 次實跑即 EB-019 的主要證據。
